rulesGroups.heading: All Matches
rulesGroups.description: Rules that apply to all matches.

rules.html: Standard FIVB Indoor rules apply except as listed in the relevant pool rules.
League points: 1 point for a win and 0 points for a loss.
If league points end in a tie, a coefficient based on Sets For and Sets Against ratio will be used.
If the sets coefficient ends in a tie, a coefficient based on Points For and Points Against ratio will be used.
If the points coefficient ends in a tie, the team with higher Points For wins.
If all of this still results in a tie, a coin toss will decide the winner.

rulesGroups.heading: Pools of 5 - Mixed
rulesGroups.description: Additional rules for five-team Mixed pools.

rules.html: All matches are best of 3 sets.
First two sets: play to 21 points, capped at 23.
Third set: first to 11 points. No win-by-two.
Teams in Mixed divisions must have at least THREE women on court at all times.

rulesGroups.heading: Pools of 5 - Men
rulesGroups.description: Additional rules for five-team Men's pools.

rules.html: All matches are best of 3 sets.
First two sets: play to 25 points, capped at 27.
Third set: play to 15 points, capped at 17.
All matches are best of 3 sets.
First two sets: play to 25 points, win by 2 points.
Third set: play to 15 points, capped at 19.
Teams in Mixed divisions must have at least THREE women on court at all times.
